title: Why You Should NEVER Give a Clock as a Gift in China
description: Thinking of gifting a nice wall clock to your Chinese friend? Maybe don't. Here's why this seemingly normal gift is a huge no-no. What's a gift rule in YOUR culture?

sections.narration: Imagine you buy a beautiful clock as a birthday gift for your Chinese friend.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy holding wrapped gift box with clock shape, warm room

sections.narration: You hand it over, all proud, and their smile just disappears instantly.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy offering gift, friend with frozen expression, warm lighting

sections.narration: Everyone in the room gets super quiet, and you have no idea why.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy confused, three people looking at floor, gift on table

sections.narration: So here's why — in Mandarin, giving a clock sounds exactly like attending a funeral.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with speech bubble showing Chinese characters, warm tones

sections.narration: The phrase 'song zhong' means both 'give a clock' and 'pay last respects.'
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy between a clock and a peaceful temple, soft golden hue

sections.narration: And it gets weirder — clocks also remind people that time is running out.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy watching clock hands move, hourglass in background

sections.narration: But here's the thing — watches are totally fine as gifts, weirdly enough.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy wearing wristwatch, happy expression, warm background

sections.narration: It's specifically wall clocks and table clocks that carry the bad meaning.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy next to wall clock with X mark, warm earth tones

sections.narration: So THAT'S why your gift made the whole room uncomfortable — it's basically a bad omen.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with lightbulb moment, clock with red X, warm room

sections.narration: Stick with red envelopes or fruit baskets, and you'll be everyone's favorite guest.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy holding red envelope and fruit basket, smiling faces around

sections.narration: Next time you're gift shopping, maybe skip the home decor clock aisle, yeah?
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy walking past clock display, waving it off, warm store
Centered: boy giving thumbs up, warm earth-toned background, simple
